fusions.name: Run Aground
fusions.desc: Drives the target onto a spur of reef that deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Hull-Breaker Shoal
fusions.desc: Raises a hidden reef under every enemy within 3.5 tiles. It deals 26 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health and leaves each [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrecker's Reef
fusions.desc: Grows a reef head beside you for 15 seconds that cuts enemies within 3 tiles for 4 damage every 1.5 seconds. Each cut has a 30% chance to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Takes Root
fusions.desc: Each time you strike, you regain 2 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
